Title: Above Sennet Cove
Caption: The shed above Sennet Cove, an hour before the light turns.

Title: By Hand
Caption: A single unbroken shaving; the plane is sharp or it is nothing.

Title: Emory Vaughn
Caption: Emory Vaughn, seventy-one, in the shed his father built.

Title: The Hull
Caption: Lapped cedar, spiled plank by plank so each edge lands sweet on the last.

Title: The Double End
Caption: The double end, where the planks meet and the boat becomes symmetrical.

Title: The Hull
Caption: Inside the hull, the run of the ribs against the planking.

Title: Steam
Caption: An oak rib clamped home hot from the steam box, still giving off steam.

Title: The Joint
Caption: Cutting a joint by mallet and chisel, the way it has always been cut.

Title: His Father's Tools
Caption: Chisels and gouges, each ground to Vaughn's own hand.

Title: Laid By
Caption: Cedar and oak air-drying on the sticks, some of it older than the apprentices.

Title: Sighting the Line
Caption: Sighting down a plank for the fair line no rule can measure.

Title: Day's End
Caption: The floor at day's end; a swept floor is a day done properly.

Title: Late Sun
Caption: Late sun off the cove, and the day's work cooling on the trestles.

Title: North Light
Caption: North light through the old window, where the day begins and ends.
